## Description

Payment adapter for Razorpay: UPI collect request / QR / payment link, card; tokenisation by provider only (no card data stored). "Paid" only after verified provider webhook (pay.pending "Awaiting provider confirmation"); timeouts → failed with retry. Webhooks verified by signature, idempotent by event id.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** An invoice becomes Paid only after a verified webhook or provider API confirmation (test with forged webhook rejected).
- [ ] **AC2.** Replaying the same webhook 10 times changes state once (idempotency test).
- [ ] **AC3.** No card number, CVV or UPI PIN is ever stored or logged.
- [ ] **AC4.** Payment failures and timeouts show "Payment failed" with retry and record-cash options.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
